title: Iris colour records of the Barred Fruiteater Pipreola arcuata from photographs and museum specimen labels
description: Iris colour of 1,414 photographed birds (3,360 images from the Macaulay Library, iNaturalist and Flickr) and 112 museum specimens in eight collections. Supporting data for Pérez, Chaparro-Herrera & Cuervo, Ibis.
